en.title: Overnight follow-list audit with batch unfollow
en.summary: A boring chore done while you sleep: audit accounts you follow, flag inactive or non-interactive ones, sort with links—then unfollow in capped batches with approval on the risky step.
en.whyItWorks: Mass cleanup is tedious and rate-limited. Separating the audit report from capped, confirmation-gated unfollow batches turns an hour-long chore into a supervised overnight job.
workflowSteps: Paste the audit prompt so the bot flags: no posts in 6+ months, never posted, no interaction with you in 30 days.
Ask for a sorted list with links and last-post context.
Review the list; remove anyone you still want to keep.
Allow unfollow of at most 100 per day, asking before each batch.
Stop if platform limits or errors appear; resume next day.
en.promptTemplate:
Audit every account I follow. Flag: no posts in 6+ months, never posted, no interaction with me in 30 days. Sort by last post, with links.

Power move: unfollow max 100/day and ask before each batch. Respect platform limits on fast mass-unfollows. Do nothing irreversible without my yes.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: X/social connector for the follow graph audit. Batch routine overnight or daily with confirm-before-unfollow. Keep the risky unfollow step approval-gated.

zh.title: 隔夜关注列表审计与分批取关
zh.summary: 一件无聊家务，趁你睡觉做完：审计你关注的账号，标出不活跃或无互动者并附链接排序——再按上限分批取关，风险步骤需批准。
zh.whyItWorks: 大规模清理又烦又有频率限制。把审计报告与有上限、需确认的取关批次分开，能把一小时苦差变成有监督的隔夜任务。
workflowSteps: 粘贴审计提示，让 Bot 标记：6 个月以上无帖、从未发帖、30 天内与你无互动。
要求按最近发帖排序的列表，并附链接。
人工审阅，剔除仍想保留的人。
每天最多取关 100，且每批前询问。
若触达平台限制或出错则停下，次日再继续。
zh.promptTemplate:
审计我关注的每个账号。标记：6 个月以上无帖、从未发帖、30 天内与我无互动。按最近发帖排序并附链接。

进阶：每天最多取关 100，且每批前询问。遵守平台对快速批量取关的限制。未经我说可以，不做不可逆操作。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 用 X/社交连接器做关注关系审计。隔夜或每日分批例行，取关前确认。风险取关步骤必须批准。

source.excerpt: Take: this is the real Grok Bot use case. Not flashy. A boring, hour-long chore done while you sleep, with your approval on the risky step.
